review:
A sushi bar on 5x4. After every spin, sushi plates with multipliers ride along a conveyor belt below the reels, and three Take Sushi symbols add up the belt's values and multiply by your bet.

Sushi chef scatters give 10 free spins, where the conveyor multipliers build up instead of resetting. Light, fun theme with a clear mechanic. Up to 3,000x, 96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
